name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods by tabish29: commit-approve, prompt-coach, mod-manager, cache-watch and usage-watch.

plugins.name: commit-approve
plugins.description: Suggests a commit message and asks for approval before git commit runs

plugins.name: prompt-coach
plugins.description: Asks targeted questions when a prompt is too vague

plugins.name: mod-manager
plugins.description: Lists the mods, shows which are active in this session, and turns them on or off

plugins.name: cache-watch
plugins.description: Shows the prompt cache state, time left before it expires, and the cost of a prompt sent with a cold cache

plugins.name: usage-watch
plugins.description: Shows the 5-hour session and weekly usage limits above the prompt, with time until reset
